findings.claim: The March 10, 2023 trilateral statement identifies China as host/sponsor of March 6–10 Beijing talks and explicitly credits Iraq and Oman with earlier 2021–22 dialogue rounds.
findings.evidenceClass: signed primary trilateral statement with explicit alternative mediation history
findings.verifiedScope: Documented host role and earlier third-party mediation
findings.attributionFinding: China participated in and hosted the concluding talks; exclusive or incremental causal contribution cannot be isolated from this statement.

findings.claim: EUPM Moldova's EU legal framework specifies financial reference amounts EUR 13,356,508.08 (24 Apr 2023–21 May 2025) and EUR 19,817,594.70 (22 May 2025–31 May 2027).
findings.evidenceClass: official EU legal financial reference amounts
findings.verifiedScope: Nominal planned financial reference amounts for two distinct mission mandate periods
findings.attributionFinding: The mission predates the EU-Moldova partnership; reference amounts do not demonstrate partnership-caused outcomes.
